# Marilla Cuthbert & Martin

- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Commands — [Martin](../character/martin.md) — hired farmhand · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. Friends and neighbors gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share their deep grief together. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues processing her sorrow with Mrs. Allan and sits with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who speaks of her upcoming eye exam and past romance with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> While returning from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) spot a cow ruining Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells the animal to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) on the spot. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow instead.
>
